title: A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame
title_zh: 面向LLM智能体的统一多元欧式桌游竞技场

paragraphs.en: Interactive environments offer a practical way to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents, and competitive games extend this evaluation to decisions shaped by competing goals and other agents’ choices. Yet existing evaluations confined to individual games or execution frameworks leave unclear which competitive advantages persist across settings. We introduce DECE ( D iverse E urogame C ompetitive E nvironments), a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols. These games combine lasting strategic commitments, competition over shared resources, and multiple routes to victory. Our primary study evaluates 12 model–harness configurations, spanning nine models and four execution harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. The main and supplementary studies comprise 1,032 completed matches in total. These comparisons reveal broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths. Matched studies show that the same model can perform differently across execution harnesses, adding another source of variation to these profiles. These performance advantages do not consistently translate into better token or cost efficiency, making resource use an additional consideration when comparing configurations. Together, the findings support evaluating complete agent configurations by both their competitive performance across games and the resources needed to achieve it.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式环境为评估大型语言模型（LLM）智能体提供了一种实用的方式，而竞技类游戏则将这种评估扩展到受对抗目标和他人智能体选择影响的决策上。 然而，现有的评估局限于单个游戏或执行框架，导致无法明确哪些竞争优势能够跨设置持续存在。 我们提出了 DECE（多样化桌游竞技环境），这是一个统一的竞技场，涵盖十款具有共享接口和评估协议的桌游。 这些游戏结合了长期战略承诺、对共享资源的竞争以及多种取胜途径。 我们的主要研究评估了 12 种模型—执行框架配置，涵盖九个模型和四种执行框架，在十款游戏中进行了 480 场三人比赛。 主研究和补充研究共包含 1,032 场已完成的比赛。 这些比较显示出广泛的跨游戏排名一致性，同时也存在游戏特定的优势。 匹配研究表明，同一模型在不同执行框架下可能表现不同，这为这些性能画像增加了另一个变异来源。 这些性能优势并不总能转化为更好的 token 或成本效率，因此在比较配置时，资源使用是另一个需要考虑的因素。 总体而言，这些发现支持从两个方面评估完整的智能体配置：其在各游戏中的竞技表现，以及实现该表现所需的资源。

paragraphs.en: How can competitive environments support reliable evaluation of
paragraphs.zh: 竞争性环境如何支持对智能体的可靠评估

paragraphs.en: complete agent systems across diverse strategic demands?
paragraphs.zh: 满足多样战略需求的完整智能体系统？

paragraphs.en: Strategy board games make this question tractable. They combine explicit rules, programmatically executable states and actions, and independently verifiable outcomes ( Gaina et al., 2020 ; Balla et al., 2024 ) . Their interactions can be represented as partially observable stochastic games (POSGs) ( Hansen et al., 2004 ) . Agents act on their observation histories; their actions determine state transitions and outcomes. We focus on Eurogames (German-style strategy board games), which combine persistent investments, competition over shared opportunities, and multiple routes to victory. In Splendor , development cards reduce later purchase costs; Azul placements constrain future spatial scoring ( Space Cowboys, n.d. ; Next Move Games, n.d. ) . These commitments shape both a player’s future options and opponents’ opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 策略棋盘游戏使这个问题变得可以处理。 它们结合了明确的规则、可通过程序执行的状态与动作，以及可独立验证的结果（Gaina et al., 2020; Balla et al., 2024）。 它们的交互可以被表示为部分可观测随机博弈（POSG）（Hansen et al., 2004）。 智能体基于其观测历史采取行动；其动作决定状态转移和结果。 我们聚焦于 Eurogame（德式策略棋盘游戏），它们结合了持续性投资、对共享机会的竞争以及多种获胜途径。 在《璀璨宝石》（Splendor）中，发展卡可以降低后续购买成本；在《花砖物语》（Azul）中，放置砖块会限制未来的空间得分（Space Cowboys, n.d.; Next Move Games, n.d.）。 这些投入既塑造了玩家自身未来的选择，也影响了对手的机会。

paragraphs.en: Existing multi-game benchmarks and harness studies provide foundations for competitive evaluation ( Costarelli et al., 2024 ; Hua et al., 2026 ) . Turning these games into a common benchmark presents three challenges. Agents need consistent observation–action interfaces across diverse rules and information structures, while retaining their tools and context management. Analysis must distinguish recurring competitive strength from game-specific advantages and account for execution settings and resource use. Reliable comparisons require consistent rule enforcement, a common participant roster , seat-balanced protocols, and verifiable outcomes. Matched scenarios and uncertainty estimates support comparisons of execution settings.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的多游戏基准与测试框架研究为竞技性评估提供了基础（Costarelli et al., 2024；Hua et al., 2026）。 将这些游戏整合为统一的基准面临三个挑战。 智能体需要在多样化的规则与信息结构之间保持一致的观察—动作接口，同时保留其工具与上下文管理能力。 分析必须区分反复出现的竞技实力与针对特定游戏的优势，并考虑执行设置与资源消耗。 可靠的比较需要一致的规则执行、统一的参与者名册、席位均衡的协议以及可验证的结果。 匹配的对局场景与不确定性估计支持对执行设置的比较。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DECE ( D iverse E urogame C ompetitive E nvironments), a unified evaluation framework spanning ten executable Eurogames. 1 1 1 The name also echoes dé cè , a Chinese shorthand for Euro-style strategy board games. The games vary in their demands for economic development, spatial commitment, and coordination across scoring routes while retaining a shared competitive structure. As illustrated in Figure 1 , a common interface exposes seat-specific observations and legal actions to pluggable execution harnesses. Each participant is a complete model–harness configuration , including its tools and context management. A common roster and seat-balanced protocols support cross-game comparisons. Separate matched studies compare the same model across harnesses, fixing setup seeds, focal seats, and opponent configurations within each scenario. Game engines enforce rules and scoring; execution records support auditing and outcome checks. We quantify uncertainty by resampling whole matches or matched scenarios. We report token use and API-equivalent cost under a fixed pricing schedule alongside competitive outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DECE（Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments，多样化欧式桌游竞技环境），一个覆盖十款可执行欧式桌游的统一评估框架。1 1 1 该名称也呼应「德策」，即欧式策略桌游的中文简称。 这些桌游在经济发展、空间投入以及多条得分路线之间的协调方面的要求各不相同，同时保留了共同的竞技结构。 如图 1 所示，一个统一接口向可插拔的执行框架暴露特定座位的观测与合法动作。 每个参与者都是一个完整的模型—执行框架配置，包括其工具与上下文管理。 通用的选手名单与座位平衡协议支持跨桌游的比较。 单独的配对研究在固定各场景中的设置种子、焦点座位与对手配置的前提下，比较同一模型在不同执行框架下的表现。 游戏引擎负责执行规则与计分；执行记录支持审计与结果核查。 我们通过对整场比赛或配对场景进行重采样来量化不确定性。 我们在固定的定价方案下报告令牌使用量与等效 API 成本，并同时报告竞技结果。

The primary study evaluates 12 model–harness configurations, spanning nine models and four harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. Rankings formed on nine games agree with the held-out game at mean Kendall τ b = 0.664 \tau_{b}=0.664 and 83.9% pair-order accuracy. Game-level profiles reveal distinct strengths and local reversals that the aggregate ranking obscures. Separate matched studies show that the same model’s performance can differ across execution harnesses. Performance–resource trade-offs vary across games, and token-based and cost-based comparisons favor different configurations. These findings support evaluating complete agent systems across multiple competitive environments, with game-level profiles and resource use reported alongside aggregate rankings.

paragraphs.en: Games provide a natural setting for evaluating LLM agents because they combine explicit rules, sequential interaction, and verifiable outcomes. Recent benchmarks span both digital and tabletop environments: Orak, BALROG, and LMGame-Bench evaluate agents across video games ( Park et al., 2026 ; Paglieri et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026a ) , while GameBench and MindGames study competitive and social reasoning in board, card, and strategy games ( Costarelli et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . FinBoardBench studies financial decisions and PTCG-Bench examines card play, harness ablations, self-evolution, and cost ( Hu et al., 2026b ; Hua et al., 2026 ) . Complementary work such as TAG and From Code to Play provides executable tabletop environments or evaluates components used by search-based players ( Gaina et al., 2020 ; Eberhardinger et al., 2024 ) , while LudoBench studies reasoning from fixed game states ( Peper et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 游戏为评估 LLM 智能体提供了天然的场景，因为它结合了明确的规则、顺序交互以及可验证的结果。 近期的基准测试同时涵盖了数字环境和桌面环境：Orak、BALROG 和 LMGame-Bench 在视频游戏中评估智能体（Park 等，2026；Paglieri 等，2025；Hu 等，2026a），而 GameBench 和 MindGames 则研究棋盘、卡牌和策略游戏中智能体的竞争性与社会性推理（Costarelli 等，2024；Wang 等，2026）。 FinBoardBench 研究金融决策，PTCG-Bench 考察卡牌玩法，此外还有关于消融实验、自我演化与成本的测试（Hu 等，2026b；Hua 等，2026）。 诸如 TAG 和 From Code to Play 等互补性工作提供了可执行的桌面游戏环境，或对基于搜索的玩家所使用的组件进行评估（Gaina 等，2020；Eberhardinger 等，2024），而 LudoBench 则从固定的游戏状态出发研究推理能力（Peper 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: DECE compares complete agent configurations across ten Eurogames with persistent investments, spatial commitments, and multiple scoring routes. A common roster measures cross-game agreement and local strengths; matched studies assess harness contrasts, and game-specific frontiers relate performance to dollars and tokens. Table 1 compares the benchmark scope.
paragraphs.zh: DECE 在十款具有持续性投资、空间布局承诺和多种得分路径的 Eurogame（欧式桌游）中比较完整的智能体配置。 统一的智能体名册用于衡量跨游戏的一致性和局部优势；配对研究评估运行框架的差异，而各游戏的前沿分析则将表现与美元和 token 数量关联起来。 表 1 比较了基准测试的范围。

paragraphs.en: DECE selects ten score-based Eurogames that share persistent strategic commitments and competition over limited opportunities, while differing in how current decisions shape future options. Table 2 groups them by three dominant, overlapping demands: building future capacity, making persistent spatial commitments, and coordinating multiple action, resource, and scoring systems. These differences allow the suite to test whether competitive advantages recur across related strategic settings or remain specific to individual games. The games also vary in interaction and information structure: players compete entirely through legal game actions, without dialogue or negotiation, and decisions may involve public or private information as well as sequential or simultaneous choices.
paragraphs.zh: DECE 选取了十款以分数为主的欧洲桌游，它们都具有持续的策略承诺以及对有限机会的竞争，同时在当前决策如何塑造未来选项方面各不相同。 表 2 按三种主要的、相互重叠的需求对它们进行分组：构建未来能力、做出持续的空间承诺，以及协调多个行动、资源与计分系统。 这些差异使该游戏组合能够检验竞争优势是在相关的策略情境中反复出现，还是仅对个别游戏具有特殊性。 这些游戏在交互与信息结构上也各不相同：玩家完全通过合法的游戏行动进行竞争，没有对话或谈判，且决策可能涉及公开或私有信息，以及顺序或同时进行的选择。

paragraphs.en: All games share an interface for setup, seat-specific observations, legal actions, state transitions, and terminal rankings. The engine enforces rules and scoring. Simultaneous choices use a frozen state and advance only after all required seats submit actions. Public information, private state, and unrevealed randomness remain separate. MCP and native adapters expose this interface; persisted states and execution records support auditing, replay, and resume (Appendix A.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Two independent studies cross OpenCode and Qwen Code in Splendor and 7 Wonders. The 72-match bridge pairs DSV4-Flash with Qwen3.8-Flash across nine scenarios per game; the 48-match within-Qwen-family study pairs Qwen3.8-Flash with Qwen3.8-Max across six. paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-Max/Qwen Code ranks first by Elo in Azul, Harmonies, and Carcassonne, and second in Burgundy. All four combine prominent spatial constraints with public current holdings under the rubric in Figure 2 ; their equal-game PWS is 84.9%. paragraphs.en: In the 48-match within-Qwen-family study, Qwen3.8-Max’s Splendor PWS rises from 33.3% under OpenCode to 91.7% under Qwen Code, a +58.3 pp contrast [50.0, 75.0]. All six matched scenarios favor Qwen Code (Figure 3 c), whereas Qwen3.8-Flash improves by only +8.3 pp in the same game. The corresponding difference in harness gains is +50.0 pp in Splendor but − - 8.3 pp in 7 Wonders (Figure 3 d), indicating that harness effects can vary across both models and games. The six positive Qwen3.8-Max/Splendor pairs yield a two-sided sign-test p = 0.03125 p=0.03125 , or 0.125 0.125 after correction for four model–game contrasts (Appendix G.3 ). We therefore view this as a strong local contrast that motivates replication, rather than evidence for a general model–harness interaction.

paragraphs.en: Point-estimate frontiers contain five to seven configurations. GPT-5.6-Luna/Codex and DSV4-Pro/DSH appear in all ten games, while GPT-5.6-Sol/OpenCode appears in nine. Qwen3.8-Max/Qwen Code lies on five frontiers, reaching the high-cost end in Wingspan (Elo 1837, $89.25), but is dominated in Burgundy and Ark Nova. GPT-5.6-Sol/Codex also lies on five frontiers and reaches the highest Elo in Brass (2068, $40.53 per appearance) and Ark Nova (2143, $37.20). For a given mean-cost budget, the staircase identifies the highest estimated Elo among affordable configurations. Moving along it shows where a higher budget changes the preferred configuration. Coverage across games describes how often a configuration is nondominated; its location within each game shows the cost and playing strength it offers.

paragraphs.en: Using mean input-plus-output tokens yields one to six frontier configurations per game (Figure 10 ). paragraphs.en: DECE combines executable Eurogames, common tournament protocols, and resource measurements linked to competitive outcomes. Together, these elements support evaluation that reports where complete agent configurations perform well, how execution choices change their results, and what resources they require.
paragraphs.zh: DECE 结合了可执行的欧洲桌游、通用的锦标赛协议，以及与竞争结果挂钩的资源度量。 这些要素共同支持一种评估方式，能够报告完整的智能体配置在哪些方面表现良好、执行选择如何改变其结果，以及它们需要哪些资源。

paragraphs.en: The POSG framework accommodates private observations, public states, and sequential or simultaneous decisions ( Hansen et al., 2004 ) . DECE exposes a seat-specific observation and legal action identifiers. Public holdings, private information, unrevealed draws, and sealed choices are recorded as distinct properties. The interface has no inter-player dialogue channel. The game engine applies rules and determines outcomes; persisted states and execution records support replay and resume. Terminal outcomes undergo the checks in Appendix D.7 .
paragraphs.zh: POSG 框架支持私有观察、公共状态以及顺序或同时决策（Hansen 等，2004）。 DECE 暴露特定座位的观察和合法动作标识符。 公开持牌、私密信息、未揭示的抽牌和密封的选择被记录为不同的属性。 该接口没有玩家之间的对话通道。 游戏引擎应用规则并确定结果；持久化状态和执行记录支持回放与续玩。 终局结果需经过附录 D.7 中的检查。

paragraphs.en: Each axis uses the following anchors. A value of zero means that the defined mechanism is absent, not that a game requires no reasoning. Hidden information concerns current private holdings; uncertainty about future random draws is excluded. Spatial planning concerns geometry and connectivity, not the mere presence of rows in a tableau.
paragraphs.zh: 每个维度使用以下锚点。 数值为零表示所定义的机制不存在，而不是说一个游戏不需要推理。 隐藏信息指当前持有的私有信息；关于未来随机抽取的不确定性不在其列。 空间规划关注的是几何与连通性，而不是牌局中仅仅存在若干排牌这一事实。

sents.zh: 空间规划关注的是几何与连通性，而不是牌局中仅仅存在若干排牌这一事实。

paragraphs.en: 0: No persistent production or action modifier; 1: Localized recurring benefit or modifier; 2: Acquired assets repeatedly change action yields, costs, or available conversions.
paragraphs.zh: 0：无持续的生产或行动修正；1：局部性的循环收益或修正；2：获得的资产会反复改变行动产出、成本或可用的转换。

paragraphs.en: 0: No geometric adjacency or connectivity constraint; 1: Geometry affects a subsidiary mechanism; 2: Adjacency, connectivity, or packing is central to placement or scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 0：无几何相邻性或连通性约束；1：几何影响某一辅助机制；2：相邻性、连通性或填充是放置或评分的核心。

paragraphs.en: 0: No material ordering dependency; 1: Resource or placement prerequisites create ordering constraints; 2: Explicit reuse, activation chains, action-strength cycles, or staged production dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 0：无材料顺序依赖；1：资源或放置前提条件形成顺序约束；2：存在显式的复用、激活链、动作强度循环或分阶段生产依赖。

paragraphs.en: 0: Independent boards and supplies; only final score comparison; 1: Shared offers, resource pools, or races; 2: Trade or shared infrastructure, contested ownership, neighbor military comparisons, or opponent-shaped compulsory leftovers.
paragraphs.zh: 0：独立棋盘与资源，仅进行最终分数比较；1：共享要约、资源池或竞赛；2：贸易或共享基础设施、所有权争夺、邻国军事比较，或由对手塑造的强制剩余物。

paragraphs.en: 0: Current decision-relevant holdings public; future random draws excluded; 1: Limited or optional private holdings; 2: Private hands or goals are a recurrent central part of decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 0：与当前决策相关的持有信息公开；未来的随机抽取被排除；1：有限或可选的私人持有；2：私人手牌或目标是决策中反复出现的核心部分。

paragraphs.en: 0: One principal additive scoring conversion; 1: Main scoring route plus a secondary bonus or threshold; 2: Overlapping, nonlinear, comparative, or staged scoring objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 0：单一的主要加分式评分转换；1：主要评分路径加上次要奖励或阈值；2：重叠的、非线性的、比较性的或分阶段的评分目标。

paragraphs.en: The colors identify three overlapping strategic emphases: building future capacity, committing space and pieces, and coordinating several systems. paragraphs.en: GameBench covers spatial strategy, social deduction, and deck building ( Costarelli et al., 2024 , Section 3.2; Appendices F–G) . MindGames reports two- through six-player settings ( Wang et al., 2026 , Section 3.2) ; FinBoardBench evaluates four-player financial board games ( Hu et al., 2026b , Sections 2–3) . PTCG-Bench uses five decks within one two-player card game and includes harness and resource analyses ( Hua et al., 2026 , Section 4; Appendices B, E–F) . From Code to Play evaluates generated state-evaluation functions in search agents across twelve TAG games ( Eberhardinger et al., 2024 , Section V-G; Table VIII) . LudoBench evaluates questions about fixed states in five tabletop games ( Peper et al., 2026 ) . The table uses GameBench v2, MindGames v1, FinBoardBench v1, PTCG-Bench v2, From Code to Play v2, and the ICLR 2026 LudoBench release.
paragraphs.zh: GameBench 涵盖空间策略、社交推理和牌库构筑（Costarelli et al., 2024，第 3.2 节；附录 F–G）。 MindGames 报告了二至六名玩家的设置（Wang et al., 2026，第 3.2 节）；FinBoardBench 评估四人金融桌游（Hu et al., 2026b，第 2–3 节）。 PTCG-Bench 在一个双人卡牌游戏中使用五套牌组，并包含测试框架与资源分析（Hua et al., 2026，第 4 节；附录 B、E–F）。 From Code to Play 在十二款 TAG 游戏中评估搜索型智能体中生成的状态评估函数（Eberhardinger et al., 2024，第 V-G 节；表 VIII）。 LudoBench 评估五款桌游中关于固定状态的问题（Peper et al., 2026）。 该表使用 GameBench v2、MindGames v1、FinBoardBench v1、PTCG-Bench v2、From Code to Play v2 以及 ICLR 2026 版本的 LudoBench。

paragraphs.en: The counters retain their game-specific source semantics. Splendor’s decision counts use player turns and omit extra noble-selection decisions. In 7 Wonders, 18 synchronous drafting rounds correspond to 54–55 recorded decisions across three players. Brass has 54 player turns but several accepted sub-decisions within a turn. In other games the recorded turn counter may itself advance at the sub-decision level; equality of turn and decision counts does not imply comparable strategic units. A larger count can therefore reflect interface granularity as well as sustained interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 计数器保留其游戏特定的来源语义。 《璀璨宝石》的决策计数以玩家回合为单位，并省略了额外的贵族选择决策。 在《七大奇迹》中，18 个同步轮抽轮次对应三名玩家共 54–55 个记录在案的决策。 《黄铜》有 54 个玩家回合，但一个回合内包含多个被接受的子决策。 在其他游戏中，记录的回合计数器本身可能在子决策层面推进；回合数与决策数相等并不意味着战略单元具有可比性。 因此，较大的计数可能反映的是界面粒度，而非持续的交互。

paragraphs.en: Random samples uniformly from legal-action entries. Heuristic uses fixed, game-specific action scores with an ϵ \epsilon -greedy policy ( ϵ = 0.1 \epsilon=0.1 ; Sutton and Barto, 2018 , Section 2.2 ), without tree search. ISMCTS uses these scores for rollouts in single-observer information set Monte Carlo tree search ( Cowling et al., 2012 ) . It accesses the native simulator with at most 1,024 simulations and 18 search steps per decision, under a 30-second wall-time target.

paragraphs.en: Controller decisions, engine decisions, and native model responses are separate units. A saved controller decision may contain several tool calls, and native usage can be available even when the controller summary lacks a token total. Usage accounting combines verified Codex native records, incremental controller usage where available, and Qwen Code native session totals or deduplicated native API responses. Input totals include cached input; output totals include reasoning when reported as a subset. All 1,440 appearances have quantified usage. The accounting scope, price scenario, and resource uncertainty are defined in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 控制器决策、引擎决策和原生模型响应是相互独立的单元。 一条已保存的控制器决策可能包含多个工具调用，即使控制器摘要中缺少令牌总量，原生用量也可能可用。 用量统计结合了经过验证的 Codex 原生记录、可用的增量控制器用量，以及 Qwen Code 的原生会话总量或去重后的原生 API 响应。 输入总量包含缓存输入；当推理部分被报告为子集时，输出总量也将其计入。 全部 1,440 次出现都具备量化的用量数据。 统计范围、价格场景和资源不确定性在附录 E 中定义。

paragraphs.en: Original-cohort usage is computed from cumulative native session counters. Duplicate snapshots contribute zero; increments and resets are checked against last-response usage before summation. The expansion instead sums unique native responses and checks them against source-log entries and seat totals. Together these sources cover all 360 primary Codex appearances. Native responses and controller decisions remain distinct units.

paragraphs.en: The scenario uses DeepSeek busy-hour rates and the Qwen3.7-Plus promotional input tier. Context-length and cache-write surcharges and non-token charges are outside this scenario. paragraphs.en: The independent study contains 48 complete three-player matches: Qwen3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max, OpenCode and Qwen Code, Splendor and 7 Wonders, and six scenarios per game.
